generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: stem subterranean and tuberlike, 25 to 30 cm long, 5 to 7.5 cm across; leaves usually two to five. Drawn as a trunk 0.032 m in radius, staying underground; 1.2 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 5 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records). Female cone solitary on a peduncle 4.5 to 5 cm, male cones one to several on peduncles 5 to 7 cm. The leaves' sizes and leaflets come from its traits; Whitelock gives no posture for its leaves.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: stem subterranean and tuberlike, 25 to 30 cm long, 5 to 7.5 cm across; leaves usually two to five, 75 to 90 cm long, the petiole 17.5 to 22.5 cm; leaflets in 16 to 25 pairs, 21 to 25 cm by 1 to 2 cm. The whole plant's height at 30 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 0.7 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: leaves usually two to five, 75 to 90 cm long with the petiole of 17.5 to 22.5 cm, 37.5 to 45 cm wide, flat: the blade, without its petiole, 52.5 to 72.5 cm (the shortest leaf less the longest petiole to the longest less the shortest).

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: petiole green, 17.5 to 22.5 cm long, 6 mm across, moderately to densely armed, the spines sometimes running on up the rachis.

traits.leaflets.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: leaflets in 16 to 25 pairs.

traits.leaflet_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: leaflets narrow to broad lanceolate, 21 to 25 cm long.

traits.leaflet_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: leaflets 1 to 2 cm wide, the margin slightly revolute, with scattered small teeth over the apical half to two thirds.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: leaves medium green; the colour by eye.

traits.cone_face_height_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: the megasporophyll's face 1.2 to 1.5 cm high by 2 to 2.5 cm wide, the facets somewhat indistinct.

traits.pollen_cone_face_height_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: the microsporophyll's face 2 to 7 mm high by 7 to 11 mm wide.

traits.cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: female cones solitary, 7 to 15 cm long.

traits.cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: female cone 4 to 5 cm across.

traits.cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 316), Zamia loddigesii: the megasporophyll's face hexagonal, 1.2 to 1.5 by 2 to 2.5 cm, its facets indistinct.

traits.cone_apex.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: female cone's apex blunt to short apiculate.

traits.cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: female cone medium brown felted; the colour by eye.

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: male cones cylindrical, 6.5 to 14 cm long.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: male cone 2 to 3 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 316), Zamia loddigesii: the microsporophyll's face 0.2 to 0.7 by 0.7 to 1.1 cm.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: male cones cylindrical.

traits.pollen_cone_apex.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: male cone's apex usually blunt.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: male cone densely tan to medium brown felted; the colour by eye.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: sclerotesta irregularly ovoid, somewhat three-sided, 12 to 14 mm long.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: sclerotesta 8 to 9 mm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: sarcotesta orange to orange-red when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 315-316), Zamia loddigesii: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
